reason: At 23 euros a litre it costs two or three times my usual syrups, and I already make my own syrups and rhums arrangés for the signature drinks. I would ask for a free sample out of curiosity, but I can't put a small new supplier through purchasing without the paperwork.
objection: I don't know whether a fermented product tastes the same from one batch to the next or how long it keeps once opened, and I've seen nothing about allergen sheets, labels, proper invoices or guaranteed delivery. If it runs out mid-season, my menu breaks.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec pack (allergen sheet, shelf life after opening, compliant labels, invoicing that fits our purchasing system) plus a sample that tastes like something I can't make myself in the back bar.
